text:
sam: Hey team — sales call with Acme Health this afternoon. They want a short POC (4 weeks). Need to lock success criteria: latency, cost, and quality thresholds + security gating. Anyone free to help scope?

ana: I can join. Quick Q: do they require VPC + KMS? That changes timing.

jordan: They flagged HIPAA and want customer-managed keys. That means Private or Dedicated with KMS integration.

sam: Confirmed — customer-managed KMS and VPC peering. Also asked for SLOs: p95 latency and expected throughput (concurrent sessions ~50).

mira: For a 4-week POC, we should propose two stages: (1) functional eval w/ sample prompts and eval suite; (2) load/latency run. Acceptance should be gated on stage 1 before stage 2.

tyler: From pricing POV, they asked for projected token burn. If we provide a dedicated pool estimate: ~200M tokens/month at peak. For POC week we can cap to 50M tokens and bill accordingly.

sam: Drafting success criteria idea: 1) Quality: pass >= 90% on their evaluator (they'll provide labeled prompts) OR no more than 8% critical errors on the canonical prompt set. 2) Latency: p95 <= 180ms for 512-token context under their expected concurrency. 3) Cost: average per-1k-token cost <= $0.85 in POC config (including reserved capacity amortized). 4) Security: KMS + VPC must be validated in first week.

ana: Suggest tightening latency to 150ms p95 if we want to be competitive, but call out that quantization or smaller model needed. Also add an availability target for POC: 99% successful inference rate (no infra errors).

jordan: We should add a QA metric: regression delta vs baseline model — e.g., no more than 2% drop in top-1 intent match relative to current production baseline.

mira: For evaluations, propose they supply: (a) 500 labeled test prompts covering edge cases, (b) a separate 200 prompt adversarial set. We'll run both and share diff reports.

tyler: Pricing note: For Dedicated short-term commit we can offer a discount if they sign a 6-month renewal. For the POC, offer a capped invoice with rollover credits if they convert.

sam: Ops checklist for week 0: - create VPC peering config - enable KMS keys and grant access - provision dedicated pool (n1-dedicated-small) - add tracing hooks in Console route - set up prompt eval harness

deploy-bot: Provision request accepted: pool_id=ded-acme-001, eta ~ 6h (still requires KMS permissions).

ana: Who owns the security questionnaire answers? We need to coordinate with security team to complete their info within 48h. I'll take point and loop in secops.

jordan: I'll prepare the latency/load test script (wrk + long-tail sim) and the prompt eval harness (we'll record outputs and compute top-1, BLEU-lite, and a custom critical-error flag).

mira: For acceptance thresholds in the signed SOW, let's be explicit: quality >= 90% AND regression <= 2%; latency p95 <= 180ms (goal 150ms); error rate <= 1% for infra failures; cost cap for POC billing <= $6k. If any of these fail, allow one remediation run after fixes.

tyler: Sounds good. I'll draft the POC SOW with those numbers and two billing options (standard POC rate vs conversion credit).

sam: Great — Ana, Jordan, Mira, Tyler: please drop comments on the SOW draft by EOD so we can finalize before the call. Call at 3pm. :thumbsup:
